# DueNudge

DueNudge is a web app for freelancers who need to follow up on unpaid invoices.

## What it does

- The freelancer creates an invoice PDF from one of four designs.
- They download the PDF and choose when to email the first reminder.
- If the invoice stays unpaid, DueNudge sends reminders 3, 7, and 14 days after the due date.
- Reminders are sent from the freelancer's own Gmail account.
- The first 3 reminder sends are free. After that, DueNudge Pro is $12 per month, with a 7-day trial when they subscribe.

## Public pages

- https://due-nudge.vercel.app/ — product overview
- https://due-nudge.vercel.app/register — create an account
- https://due-nudge.vercel.app/login — log in

Account pages, invoices, clients, and files are private and should not be indexed.
